text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Sigh, going straight home like this would 
be so boring. I wonder if there's anything 
fun to do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since I saw how happy she was at 
the zoo, I've been looking into spots she 
might enjoy. Now seems like the time to 
reveal them!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's this? You're awfully fired up. It'd 
better be actually interesting, alright?
choice_data_list:
I handpicked the best spots related to 
magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm? If you're really that confident, I 
guess I could go along with it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I brought her to the filming 
location of a sword-and-sorcery fantasy 
adventure movie... however.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"A place where witches engaged in a fierce 
battle —that's what you said, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh......)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Did you reaaally use magic here? It's 
weird that there isn't a single trace of 
magic left!
choice_data_list:
N-Next time, let's go somewhere we can see 
magic!

text_block_list.name: Wandering Magician
text_block_list.text: Abra~cadabra~ Tidbits~ sesame-bits~...

text_block_list.name: Wandering Magician
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Only the card the young lady picked 
has vanished! Wow, fantastic!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy, that's magic? The card just 
vanished, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Wandering Magician
text_block_list.text: Wha-!? Y-You're not surprised... you say!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma's magic is way, way more amazing! 
You're still just a fledgling!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Now this has quite the atmosphere♪ Is 
it some kind of ritual?

text_block_list.name: Ascetic-looking Person
text_block_list.text:
Rin, Pyo, To, Sha, Kai, Jin, Retsu, Zai, 
Zen... KAAAAAAATZ!!!

text_block_list.name: Ascetic-looking Person
text_block_list.text:
...Now, you two join in as well. 
Volunteers for this precious 
'Miracle☆Training Experience'... I 
won't... let you... get away...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, aren't they inching closer...? 
Something's weird here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...None of those places were anything like 
I pictured. I thought anything related to 
'magic' would be fine, so I suppose my 
research was too shallow...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, familiar. Are you done already?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's with the pale face? ...Aha, so that 
means you...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez! You really are a useless familiar! 
You need more training, I say, more 
training!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Here, drink this at least!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That tea is sure to be perfect for someone 
lacking in discipline like you! Because it 
tastes absolutely, utterly repulsive!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Sweat will pour from your entire body to 
the point of collapsing! Come on, hurry up 
and drink it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho edges closer. In an instant, 
she grabs hold of me and shoves a 
mysterious drink into my mouth!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A spine-chilling shock coursed through my 
entire body! My mouth was overtaken by an 
unbearable bitterness, and all the 
strength drained right out of me—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're awake! Pfft♪ You had the 
funniest face on, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"So, how was it? How does it feel to 
collapse? Oh, is it so vomitously 
disgusting that you still can't speak?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My body feels surprisingly light. As if 
all the fatigue from today had simply 
blown away somewhere. Could the one who 
gave me that tea be—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, it's a special concoction 
handed down from Grandma! Perhaps it was a 
bit too stimulating for a familiar?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, now you're able to move again, 
right? Make sure you keep devoting 
yourself starting tomorrow!
choice_data_list:
The taste is downright traumatizing, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Are you complaining about the 
taste of medicine?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I have medicine that's waaaay more bitter 
and works even better! Maybe I should 
prepare that one for you next time~?"
choice_data_list: T-This tea is more than enough!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I can make this tea for you anytime, 
so don't worry and push yourself until 
you're completely exhausted!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her gentle, caring smile, I 
resolved to make sure she has a truly 
great time next time...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, of course! Taking care of my 
familiar is my job too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'll gladly accept this token of 
gratitude for being such a sweet master♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Touched by her gentle words of concern, I 
resolved to make sure she has a truly 
great time next time...!
